text:
maria: Hey folks — opened a tiny docs PR to fix the JS quickstart auth example. If anyone's got 2 mins can you check the token usage? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
aj: on it, will skim now
sam: I can look after my meeting in ~20m
taylor: left one suggestion about fetch headers — might be clearer to show Bearer vs API-Key
maria: thx! here's current snippet:
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Token ' + API_KEY },
  body: JSON.stringify({prompt: 'hi'})
})
```
maria: thinking to change to `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` and mention env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY
aj: +1 for Bearer and env var, also call out region header for EU users maybe
taylor: nit: prefer `const res = await fetch(...); const json = await res.json()` example to show streaming caveat
maria: ok I'll update. CI is green btw — devex-bot: build passed
devex-bot: CI: docs tests — success https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876
sam: looked quick, left an approval
aj: approved
taylor: approved with one nit, not blocking
maria: thanks all — will merge in ~30m unless anyone objects
sam: go for it
maria: merged and will deploy docs site, thanks :tada:
aj: nice, will update SDK quickstart repo to match
maria: follow-up: if someone wants to also add the env var note to the Python quickstart I can open a PR next week
jen: I can pick that up
maria: awesome, tagging @jen. thanks everyone!
